text:
amanda: PTAL — I pushed fixes to https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pull/432 (rebased on main). Short summary: fixed kv-cache eviction edge, added rotation unit test, updated changelog, and reduced canary traffic from 50% -> 20% for safety. PTAL when you have a minute.

sahil: Quick skim — looks smaller now. Where's the new env var wired? I couldn't spot it in runtime startup.

amanda: It's in runtime/config/env.go, I added `REDWOOD_KV_EVICTION_JITTER` with a fallback. Diff excerpt below for context:
```
const DefaultEvictionJitter = 0.1
// read env override for eviction jitter
jitter := parseFloat(os.Getenv("REDWOOD_KV_EVICTION_JITTER"), DefaultEvictionJitter)
```
(also added a test that exercises jitter bounds).

olga: Ran unit + small integration locally, tests pass. One request: can you add a 1-2 line smoke command in the PR body showing the canary route and expected 2xx so ops can re-run quickly?

amanda: Good call — added smoke instructions to the PR body and pinned the curl example: 
```
# canary smoke (use $TOKEN)
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-base","input":"hello world"}' \
  https://canary.api.redwood.ai/v1/generate | jq '.status == "ok"'
```

sahil: Nice. LGTM after that. Can someone from MergeOps claim custody for a low-traffic merge window? We should schedule 30-60m to watch canary metrics.

merge-ops: @amanda I've reserved a 07:00 PST merge slot on 2026-03-21 and tagged the PR with canary metadata. Please post when you're ready to hand off (15m before).

amanda: Thanks — will squash and request custody ping 15m prior. PTAL @olga @sahil :wave:

olga: :thumbsup: Everything else looks clean to me.

sahil: :+1: approving now.

amanda: Performing final local merge sanity, will wait for canary pass then merge. Thanks everyone.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started: pr/432 -> canary-2026-03-21-07:05 (monitored metrics: latency, errors).

amanda: Canary passed basic latency + 200 smoke checks. Proceeding to merge now. Appreciate the quick reviews! :rocket:
